name: app-customer-request-slide-with-cutout-portrait-and-oversized-quote-mark
title: Customer Request with Portrait and Quote Mark
whatItIs: A white page with two rounded panels: a blue-grey gradient panel with a giant white logo swirl and a smiling woman with headphones holding a phone, with a white transaction card at the base, and a pale panel with a Customer Request pill, huge grey quotation marks, a quote about a smarter unified wallet and an avatar with name and role.
whatItMeans: A photo panel and a quote panel side by side pair face and voice, and the giant logo swirl brands the photo.
techniques: Two equal panels of photo and quote
Giant logo swirl behind the portrait
Transaction card overlapping the photo base
Oversized quote marks in pale grey
Avatar and role under the quote

vocabulary.definition: A panel holding a statement from a customer.
An oversized fragment of a logo used as a backdrop.
A UI card placed over a photograph.
